subject: Mutual action plan commencement — Clearwell evaluation & timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Priya Sharma <priya@clearwellhealth.com>
Cc: Grace O'Connor <grace_oconnor@redwood.com>, Aditya Rao <aditya_rao@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 09:15:00 -08:00
Subject: Mutual action plan commencement — Clearwell evaluation & timeline

Hi Priya —

Thanks again for the demo yesterday — really appreciated the time. Per our conversation, I want to put a short mutual action plan (MAP) on your calendar to align goals, owners, and a proposed evaluation timeline so we can keep momentum.

High-level proposal (please tweak):
- Objective: Proof of concept to validate Redwood inference for secure clinical note summarization and cost-per-token targets under Clearwell's latency SLOs.
- Evaluation window: 6 weeks (pilot/technical validation + executive review) — target close: 2026-12-24.
- Success criteria (examples): 1) 95th percentile latency < 350ms for 512 tokens; 2) summary ROUGE-L parity >= 0.88 vs current baseline on sample set; 3) token cost <= $0.0018.
- Core owners: Priya (Champion / Product), Tom (Procurement), Leena (DS), Marcus (AE), Grace (CSM), Aditya (SE).

I've attached a one-page MAP workbook (Clearwell_MAP_v1.xlsx) and a draft SOW for procurement to start reviewing. Can you confirm: 1) the internal owner list above, 2) any additional decision criteria, and 3) availability for a 30-min kickoff call next week (I can do Mon/Tue 10–12 PT)?

Next steps once we confirm: we (Aditya + Grace) will schedule an integration checklist walkthrough, and I will share a one-pager on the evaluation data needs and SOC2 artifacts.

Thanks — looking forward to aligning.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
marcus_lin@redwood.com | +1 (415) 555-0187

Attachments: Clearwell_MAP_v1.xlsx (workbook), SOW_Clearwell_draft.pdf (draft), SOC2_summary.pdf (summary)
From: Priya Sharma <priya@clearwellhealth.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
Cc: Tom Ellis <tom.ellis@clearwellhealth.com>, Leena Kapoor <leena.k@clearwellhealth.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Mutual action plan commencement — Clearwell evaluation & timeline

Marcus — thanks for the follow-up and the materials. Quick answers below and a couple requests.

We like the proposed objective and 6-week window — that timeline works for our exec review cadence. Confirmed internal owners:
- Product / Champion: Priya Sharma (me)
- Procurement: Tom Ellis (cc)
- Data Science lead: Leena Kapoor (cc)
- Engineering: will confirm once we sync with platform infra (I'll loop them if needed)

Decision criteria additions: please add an item for encryption-in-transit verification and a short-term retention cap (14 days) for PII-labeled inputs. Also, we will need a SOC2 report (or summary) and evidence of KMS integration before we can start a pilot with production data.

Kickoff: Tue Nov 16 11:00–11:30 PT works for me. Tom — are you available?

Also, procurement wants the SOW draft and a high-level pricing band for a 6-week eval (not the final quote, just an estimate) to share with finance.

Thanks — Priya
Priya Sharma
Head of Product, Clearwell Health
priya@clearwellhealth.com | +1 (617) 555-2248

Thanks Priya — great to have the owners confirmed. Tom and Leena — appreciate you joining the thread.

Action items I will take (by EOD Friday):
- Share a short pricing band for a 6-week eval and an accompanying one-pager for finance.
- Share the SOC2 summary and a short notes doc on how KMS integration is supported in our Private deployment options (SOC2_summary.pdf attached).
- Update the MAP workbook with encryption & retention items and circulate v1.1.

Grace — can you take point on SOW draft finalization and tracking procurement questions? Aditya — can you prepare a 20-min integration checklist for Tue's call (we'll keep it high level, infra-friendly).

Confirmed kickoff: Tue, 16 Nov 2026, 11:00–11:30 PT — I'll send a calendar invite and a short agenda (goal alignment, success criteria, integration checklist, procurement next steps).

If anyone needs a different time, flag it and we'll adapt.

Best,
Marcus
